subject: Money
title: Shrinkflation
description: A short lesson to help you apply Shrinkflation.

hook.text: A bag of Doritos went from 9.75 oz to 9.25 oz. Same price, same bag, less product. You didn't notice.

buildup.text: Shrinkflation hides price increases by reducing quantity instead of raising the listed price.

discovery.text: Companies know consumers notice price changes but not size changes. Smaller packaging is invisible inflation.

twist.text: Toilet paper rolls have a cardboard tube 50% wider than in 2000. Less paper, same price, same outer diameter.

climax.text: CPI tries to catch shrinkflation by measuring price-per-unit. But many consumers never check the unit price.

punchline.text: Same price. Less inside. Welcome to shrinkflation.

quiz.question: What is shrinkflation?
options: Products getting smaller while the price stays the same
